title: Build quality impression and power delivery
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on how the car’s build quality, driving feel, and power delivery shape owners’ overall impression, with many fragments too context-light to classify clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the car as comfortable, well built, enjoyable to drive, and strong in performance or battery-assisted boost.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the car leaves a poor impression or feels less well built than earlier BMWs.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention impressions of size, solidity, equipment expectations, interior cheapness, acceleration, range, or power without enough context to classify sentiment reliably.

limitations: Many sampled fragments use vague 'impression' or 'gives' phrasing without enough surrounding context to determine sentiment confidently.
